# Turkish and Morphologically Rich Languages {#sec-turkish-nlp}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- explain what agglutination does to vocabulary size, tokenization, and every downstream metric;
- measure tokenizer fertility and convert it into a real cost difference;
- normalize Turkish text without destroying it;
- choose between multilingual and monolingual models on measured evidence.

## Exercises

1. Measure tokenizer fertility for three tokenizers on the same Turkish paragraph and its English translation. Convert the difference into monthly API cost at 1M requests.
2. Find a Turkish sentence where naive lowercasing changes the meaning. Explain the fix in one sentence.
